_comment: CAUSE-POSES (1 Nov 2026): roster-wide hurt/faint settle for every rig (F36 recipes and own-clip/remake species), scripts/creatures/creature_pose_settle.gd. The master `enabled` (OFF) is the GPU arm; each section keeps its own switch (ON inside the arm) so an arm can drop one. faint.grounded: dense pivot keys plant every faint sample on the standing ground line and re-centre the posed body over its contact shadow. faint.side_lie: rolls about the body's forward axis until the legs lie out to the side; a standing or crouched faint takes roll_sign (+1 rolls the back toward the body's right), a faint already on a side or legs-up keeps its side. faint.head_lift: the neck lifts a buried or downward head at faint end (limbed bodies only). Legless rigs (snakes, rays, moths) keep their authored fall, grounded. faint.crumple (owner, 1 Nov): bodies that look odd on their side (winged and legless rigs, plus listed shelled, many-legged, seal, ray, serpent and amphibian shapes) collapse onto the ground instead: legs under the body with a slight slump, legs folding out so the belly drops, head sinking to the ground. faint.face_camera: at play_faint the settled collapse turns (ramped, about its standing centre) so the body lies across the camera's view with its back toward the camera (no end-on blob, belly away). hit.recoil: a hit that barely moves gains a held pivot recoil. hit.grounded: every hit sample is planted (no hop). Composes with f36_pose_candidates.json flags (including roster_pose_r1) and creature_clip_flags.json: it reads whatever clip those leave.

lanekit_mosshell_scope._why: F38#26 P2-020 (LANE-KIT, 7 Nov 2026; CPU 6.53, GPU 5.43): all three judges read the fainted Mosshell as translucent and not grounded; on a crop it is a belly-up faint floating about half a body above the grass. When on, this file's settle runs for Mosshell only (faint grounded + crumple, which rights a belly-up fall onto the plastron and plants it; hit grounded), while the roster-wide master stays OFF. Presentation only. OFF until judged.
lanekit_mosshell_scope.scope: client presentation: faint/hit clips of the listed species; no state
lanekit_mosshell_scope._why_on: LANE-KIT 7 Nov 2026, qj F38-26-8ba717064855-11072338: F38#26 CPU mapped 6.27 -> 6.97 (+0.70; raw 5.3 5.6 5.5 -> 5.8 6.0 6.0). All three judges: the fainted Mosshell no longer reads as a pale translucent ghost; it sits as an opaque shell on the ground. Judged gain ships ON.

tidewake_scope._why: NEAR6-TW (4 Nov 2026), P2-028 / F39#6 (GPU 5.61): Tidewake fainted Riptusk (owner1101 remake, no F36 recipe, so the UIPOSES Riptusk flag cannot reach it) and Aquaryn keep upright crouches with raised heads. When on, this file's settle (every section as configured) runs for the listed species only, while the roster-wide master `enabled` stays OFF for CAUSE-POSES' GPU arm.
tidewake_scope.scope: client presentation: faint/hit clips of the listed species; no state

floor2_aquaryn_scope._why: F39#6 close-out (LANE-FLOOR2, 11 Nov 2026; GPU High 7.24 on aquaryn idle, resting, fainted). Judges 3/3: the fainted pose has stiff legs up in the air, the body looks lifted off the sand, and resting and fainted are nearly the same pose. When on, this file's settle runs for Aquaryn only (tidewake_scope also lifts Riptusk off the sand, so it is not used). Presentation only. OFF until judged.
floor2_aquaryn_scope.scope: client presentation: faint/hit/rest clips of the listed species; no state
floor2_aquaryn_scope._why_on: Ships ON (11 Nov 2026). LANE-SCOUT G-floor2-aquaryn-settled-rest (tb/item-scout-1108 ee82bdaee), GPU High: F39#6 6.75 -> 7.47, +0.72, 3/3 judges. With settled_rest.rest_only it changes Aquaryn's rest only.

settled_rest._why: F39#6 close-out (LANE-FLOOR2, 11 Nov 2026, OFF until judged). A species that rests by replaying its faint keeps the original faint as its rest when the settle is on, so its rest is the stiff side-lie. When on, the listed species rest on a clip baked from the same faint: belly to the ground like the settled faint, with the head kept up (lying awake), so rest and faint read as two states. Needs the settle to run for the species (a scope or the master switch).
settled_rest._why_on: Ships ON (11 Nov 2026). LANE-SCOUT G-floor2-aquaryn-settled-rest (tb/item-scout-1108 ee82bdaee), GPU High: F39#6 6.75 -> 7.47, +0.72, 3/3 judges; the judges call the rest 'a believable low crouch ... grounded and reads as resting'. Next for the row: a grounded faint with slack or folded legs.
settled_rest._rest_only_why: The species keeps its own faint and hit clips and takes only the baked rest. On CPU the settled Aquaryn faint turned belly-up and floated above its shadow, no better than the shipped one, so only the rest is changed.

grounded._limb_sink_why: The trunk rests on the ground and limbs may sink up to 20% of standing height: grounding on the single lowest vertex propped remake bodies up on one flipper or leg tip (CPU marker probe: Abyssal Guardian balanced on a fin).

level_trunk._why: Remake faints that end sitting or standing up (GPU on remakes: Abyssal Guardian 'begging seal', Galewisp and Riverdrake upright, Ribbonray on its tail) pitch down until pelvis-to-head is no steeper than max_trunk_deg, before the side roll.

side_lie._keep_side_why: A faint already on a side or legs-up keeps the side it fell to (CPU stage: a fixed roll_sign flipped Mudsnout, Galecrest and Stormursa over through upright); roll_sign only orients standing or crouched faints.
side_lie._exclude_why: No roll at all: Voltarach's curled faint has no reliable leg axis (CPU probe: a 132 deg roll); Galecrest's own wing-collapse already lies on its side (creature_body.gd rest_roll_deg note).

crumple._why: Owner, 1 Nov 2026: 'Some of the creatures shouldn't go on their sides when they faint. They should just collapse onto the ground.' These bodies look odd on their side, so they crumple instead: legs back under the body (a belly-up fall is righted) with a slight slump to one side, legs folding out so the belly drops onto the ground, head sinking to the ground. Winged and legless rigs crumple automatically; the list adds shelled, many-legged, seal, ray, serpent and amphibian shapes. keep_authored never crumples (Galecrest's liked wing-collapse).
crumple._legs_why: CPU (remakes ON): auto-rigged remakes skin most leg mesh to the pelvis and spine, so trunk grounding left four-legged crumplers standing. Their torso (spine) now sinks to torso_drop_ratio of its standing height over the clip's second half; legs fold out splay_deg and pass into the ground, reading as legs giving way.
crumple._tidecoil_why: Tidecoil lies on its side (it reads well there, and its tall dorsal fins let a crumpled body sink out of sight).
